source: ops-cv iou_v2 aclnn 实测（warmup=3, repeats=3, msprof --ai-core task_time 中值）; measured impl = /home/zzy-work/refgen_perf_audit/adapters/ref16_iou_v2.py. Caliber: warmup=25, repeats=10, per-case msprof capture, trailing-10 mean; gap-fenced iteration seg | 2026-09-15 case 重设（放大 shape 命中目标分档）后按本管线口径全量重测；新增 latency_band_distribution。
caliber: warmup=25, repeats=10, per-case msprof capture, trailing-10 mean; gap-fenced iteration segmentation (instrumented sync+sleep separator, floor 9 ms); convergence gate = |drift| <= 5% on mean(2nd half of last 10)/mean(1st half), judged separately for e2e and core

window_mix.note: extended_cases were re-measured ONLY after failing the convergence gate at the modal window; no case that already passed was re-rolled. paired_ab_bound_pct is the largest per-case move seen in a same-case paired A/B between the modal and the extended window (null = not established for this operator, which is NOT the same as zero).

cases.flops_note: iou_v2 mode=iou aligned=True: 8 pairs x 13 flop/pair + 3 x (8+8) shared box areas; ARITHMETIC ONLY -- the companion `Transpose` layout kernel (in e2e_us, stripped from core_us) is not counted. Measured engine profile (kept op_summary, 4 cases spanning 16 -> 16.8M pairs; figures in pct of aiv_time): MTE3 (write-back) 16-94 rising with size, scalar 20-57, vector ALU 11-22, MTE2 2-7. On the large cases that dominate the geomean (40/42/47, 262k-16.8M pairs) MTE3 is 90.6-94.1 pct -- this kernel is WRITE-BACK bound, not MTE2/read bound. So prefer achieved_bw_gbs over mfu_pct (and note bytes_moved charges each box once, the algorithmic minimum, so that bandwidth is a strict lower bound)
